description.title: Why Twenty - Twenty Documentation
description.snippet: Why Twenty You've been choosing between software that's easy to start but impossible to change, and software that's flexible but takes months to set up. Twenty is the third option: a production-ready CRM you can reshape as you go. ... Twenty is a platform you can build on, not a product you configure.

description.title: What is Twenty - Twenty Documentation
description.snippet: At first, Twenty looks like most CRMs you already know: you can track deals, organize contacts, manage tasks and notes. But what sets it apart is our approach to extensibility. We are building an open platform that provides the building blocks for you to solve your unique business problems.

description.title: Twenty CRM Features — Modern Open Source CRM Platform
description.snippet: Pipelines, custom objects, AI assistants, and a native API on top of Postgres. Twenty is the open source CRM with the modern UX teams actually want to use.

description.title: Why Twenty — The Open Source CRM Built to Be Customised
description.snippet: Packaged CRMs make every company look the same. Twenty is the open source CRM teams shape around their workflow, with a modern UI and a developer-first platform.

description.snippet: Build your Enterprise CRM at AI Speed Twenty gives technical teams the building blocks for a custom CRM that meets complex business needs and quickly adapts as the business evolves.

authentication.title: OAuth - Twenty Documentation
authentication.snippet: Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access. Clients are registered dynamically via RFC 7591 — no manual setup in a dashboard.

authentication.title: APIs - Twenty Documentation
authentication.snippet: The API is generated from the schema, so endpoints use your object and field names directly — no opaque IDs. Your workspace-specific API documentation is available under Settings → API & Webhooks after creating an API key.

authentication.title: Connections - Twenty Documentation
authentication.snippet: Today only OAuth 2.0 is supported. Future credential types (personal access tokens, API keys, basic auth) will plug into the same surface — apps already using defineConnectionProvider ( { type: 'oauth', ... }) won’t need to migrate.

authentication.title: Developers - Twenty Documentation
authentication.snippet: Apps Extend Twenty with custom objects, server-side logic, UI components, and AI agents — all as TypeScript packages.

authentication.title: MCP Server - Twenty Documentation
authentication.snippet: Go to Settings → MCP & APIs → MCP in Twenty. Choose your authentication method (OAuth or API Key), copy the JSON snippet (it will already use your workspace URL), and paste it into your MCP client’s config file.

authentication.title: Twenty | #1 Open Source CRM
authentication.snippet: It is just such a nicer experience than dealing with a Salesforce or a HubSpot. My mission has been to get every tool API-accessible, so everything talks to each other. Twenty made that possible in a way older CRM platforms simply do not.

webhooks.title: Webhooks - Twenty Documentation
webhooks.snippet: Webhooks push data to your systems in real-time when events occur in Twenty — no polling required. Use them to keep external systems in sync, trigger automations, or send alerts.

webhooks.title: Webhooks - Twenty Documentation
webhooks.snippet: Webhooks Get notified when records change — HTTP POST to your endpoint on every create, update, or delete. Twenty sends an HTTP POST to your URL whenever a record is created, updated, or deleted. All object types are covered, including custom objects.

webhooks.title: Webhooks - Twenty Documentation
webhooks.snippet: Webhooks Ricevi una notifica quando i record cambiano — HTTP POST al tuo endpoint a ogni creazione, aggiornamento o eliminazione. Twenty invia un HTTP POST al tuo URL ogni volta che un record viene creato, aggiornato o eliminato. Tutti i tipi di oggetto sono supportati, inclusi gli oggetti personalizzati.

webhooks.title: APIs - Twenty Documentation
